observations: Photo 0 is a single shot of used car parts leaning against a wall outdoors.
Two CV drive shafts (axle shafts) with rubber boots, one lying diagonally in front, both dusty with surface rust on the splines.
A rack and pinion steering rack with a hydraulic valve body and pipes, standing upright at the back.
A thin parallel flow core on the right with a mounting bracket and a side receiver tube; it looks like an AC condenser rather than an engine radiator.
A starter motor on the floor, sitting on a pulley or balancer that is not in the seller's list.
A brake caliper or bracket at the bottom of the frame, also not in the list.
No brand, part number or vehicle make can be read; one small white sticker on a drive shaft is too small and angled to read.
Parts are dusty, rusty and of mixed metals (steel shafts and rack, aluminium condenser, rubber boots, a motor with copper windings), not clean or sorted by grade.
No scale, weigh slip or tape measure is shown.
